datasheet: /home/user/OpenAIO-Whoop/research/DESIGN-SPEC.md §4.10 'USB' row: 4 pogo pads 1.0 x 1.0 mm (ENIG; D+, D-, +5V_USB, GND) on the bottom at the top edge, two NPTH alignment holes Ø 0.8 and Ø 1.1 so the clip-on adapter (O3) fits one way only; §10 region table (holes 1.5 mm apart); DRU 'NPTH at least 0.50'
derivation: pads in one row at 1.27 mm pitch (standard pitch of off-the-shelf spring-contact strips for the O3 adapter; 0.27 copper gap, 0.19 mask web at the 0.04 expansion); NPTH Ø 0.80 and Ø 1.10 1.50 apart (spec), centred on the row and 1.35 inboard (+y): hole edges 0.30 (Ø 1.1) and 0.45 (Ø 0.8) from pad copper, 0.55 hole to hole; pin 1 at -x on the Ø 0.8 side (adapter key); no paste (flat contacts), pad property test point; body = pads + holes (no component body); B.CrtYd keeps the holes clear of parts on the other side. Pin order is set in the schematic (suggested 1 +5V_USB, 2 D-, 3 D+, 4 GND = USB order, data pair in the middle)
